description_en: Specifies a correct device identifier for a device that has multiple device identifiers in the unique-certificate-per-product authentication scenario without pre-registration, to prevent unauthorized device logons
description_zh: 一型一密免注册场景下，若设备包含多个设备标识，需调用该接口指定一个正确的设备标识，以防止非法的设备登录
kebab_example: aliyun iot transform-client-id --iot-id BXPV9Ks3bxwM9fD00000000101 --client-id 9rSz00000000UNMWj33f000112 --iot-instance-id iot-02000043 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TransformClientId

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If <props="intl"><ph>the **Overview** page or </ph></props>the ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
